Exactly. And the funds MUST be converted to fiat, and restructured. This is how the Ethereum Foundation works.

Given the scale of funds and the fact that elections happen, I would suggest a custodian be a guardian of a trust with a defined document, a large, established entity such as JPMorgan. They can administer and verify elections by appointing trustees who are bound by fiduciary duty (read: legal principle as old as law itself that bounds a trustee to act in good faith, with insane penalties and criminal punishments under contract law for violations)

This ensures the fund is managed prudently, and allows us to give elected members ultimate power while still ensuring they can't, and no offense, run away with the funds, while ensuring no other party bears control over it too.

Much like a smart contract, except this one is globally recognised, reputable, can't be hacked, and is legally enforceable.

Critics will object on decentralisation grounds. Zcash's development is basically centred across 5 organisations, and now billionaires....

It is time to reset all perspectives. You should definitely oppose what is now being presented as a "compromise", because it is in fact the furthest-reaching attempt to create a purely political dependency on the core founders, and it would build a legal shell around them for immunization from all liability at "network" expense. How would you characterize this design mechanism?

i joined the forum in 2020 to specifically argue against broadly the extension of the initial founders reward under MGRC in 2020.  I will spare the told you sos because anyone here long enough knows that a community grant product that ended up being a critical product for the community.

consider the discussions in 2020 as to "forking the forum" when the founding team and ECC recognized they are openly created this continuing ongoing technical and political debt and their unique social and legal liabilities that follow.  Now the proposition is that should anyone oppose "the Devs" you will be speaking to legal at network expense.

What "legal"  What "firm" What "country"?

**[u]vehemently[/u]** oppose this "compromise"

I have logged into this forum 742 days, viewed and read thousands of posts and topics before even becoming a member, and have never received 1 single cent from any community member, or funding for anything.
